title: SpellCore Focus: Important Systems
summary: Read focus items, spell definitions, aether costs, cooldowns, and starter effects.

blocks.title: Focus Items
blocks.body: Signal Focus is playable now; Aether Focus, Spell Deck, blank cores, engraved cores, and overcharged cores define the future spell equipment space.

blocks.title: Starter Spells
blocks.body: Signal Pulse disrupts and marks, Aether Bolt hits directly, and Ash Veil grants a short concealment or survival window.

blocks.title: State Rules
blocks.body: Selected spell, aether cost, cooldown, targeting mode, cast type, and server authority all matter more than raw button speed.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
